pages.text: It was the day of the Makar Sankranti festival, and the sky was dotted with hundreds of colorful kites. <name> was running across the terrace, holding his favorite kite — a bright orange one with shiny tassels that fluttered like flames. But just as he prepared to launch it high, a sudden gust of wind snatched the kite from his hands, carrying it away into the bustling festival below.
“Wait! My kite!” <name> shouted, chasing after the string that had slipped from his fingers.

He darted through the crowded streets, careful not to bump into other festival-goers. Soon, he spotted a piece of orange string caught in the branches of a mango tree. “This must be it!” he exclaimed. He tried to climb the tree, but the branch swayed, and he realized he needed a safer plan.

Looking around, he noticed a group of friends and festival helpers nearby. Together, they fashioned a long stick from bamboo and carefully nudged the string, freeing the kite. It floated just out of reach again, tangled in the decorative flags above the market stalls.
<name> took a deep breath, observed the pattern of the ropes, and guided his friends to form a human chain, steadying the kite as it finally came loose.

The kite soared back into the sky, spinning gracefully against the golden sun. <name> laughed with relief and joy. “We did it!” His friends cheered, and even the festival crowd clapped at the daring rescue.

As <name> held the kite string firmly this time, he realized how important persistence, careful observation, and teamwork had been in solving the mystery of the missing kite. What had started as a frantic chase turned into a shared adventure, filled with laughter, clever thinking, and pride.

The festival continued with colorful kites dancing in the sky, and <name> felt a warm glow of accomplishment. He had learned that even when things seem lost, paying attention to details, asking for help, and staying calm can turn a problem into a memorable triumph.
By sunset, his kite was the brightest in the sky, fluttering like a flame above the village, reminding <name> that curiosity, cleverness, and teamwork make any adventure — or mystery — magical.
